newsitem.title: USA: State Street Capital plans Beverage Works IPO.
newsitem.headline: State Street Capital plans Beverage Works IPO.

text.p: Beverage Works Inc has filed for an initial public offering of one million units to price at $8 each to be underwritten by State Street Capital.
Each unit will consist of one share of common stock and one Class A redeemable warrant to price at $8 each, according to its prospectus.
State Street said it had no information about when the initial public offering might be brought to market.
State Street was formed August 2, 1995 to buy and operate craft breweries and has yet to post a profit, according to its prospectus.

It said in a September filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission that it was planning to buy two brewing companies, Heritage Brewing Co of Lake Elsinore, California and Orange Empire Brewing Co and has other partnerships. It said it will market a total of 26 different beers.
For the four months ended April 30, 1996, it had sales of $100,076 and lost $641,484 on a historical basis.

The company also said in its prospectus that it plans to finance future acquisitions, if any, by cash and debt or equity securities including shares of its common stock and said it will need additional debt or equity financing to implement its acquisition strategy.

State Street has also been the lead underwriter on two separate companies which had filed to go public earlier this year, Chic Chick Inc and Proformix Inc. Chic Chick, which was filed in July, was put on hold. Proformix, which filed in September, has also not yet gone public.
